items.title: Shirley Lewis Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: he and Ron Johnson used to kid me a lot... they coaxed me into eating... that's about all I can recall from, Johnston.

ctx.x: And Lisa was one who didn't care to eat very much. And, um, he and Ron Johnson used to kid me a lot. At least, Ron did anyway, about eating my food all the time. Every time my mother would fix it, I wouldn't eat it. And he'd say, well, he was going to eat my food. So, between the two of them, they coaxed me into eating. And, um, I don't know, I just more or less took to Bill Russell. And from that time on up until now, every Christmas, he sends me my Christmas card with a $5 bill in it. And, I don't know, I just…
What about Bump? Do you remember Bump in those days very much?

No, except for him wanting to eat my food all the time. That's why the only thing I can remember. He wanted to eat it? I didn't want to eat it. He figured if he said he'd eat it, I'd eat. Oh, I see. I'd get mad and want to eat. But, uh, that's about all I can recall from, Johnston.
